meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. Alignment is a number. You can miss 0.25. The packets miss it. A conditional is not a bound.

lemmas.name: B25_align_readable
lemmas.statement: strain identity, undepleted CONC, and the CF conditional are readable together
lemmas.why: Eigenframe residual is roundoff. Median |cos α_3| sits near 1/2. IF less aligned, stretching is smaller. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B25a_depletion_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: 3-CONC depletion of |cos α_3| closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Median sits near 1/2. CONC is a spectrum, not an alignment. A slogan the packets miss is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B25b_frame_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: Ring Lipschitz plus the CF conditional is a closed a priori for classical X
lemmas.why: Direction slowly varying is not direction aligned (B14b). IF less aligned, stretching is smaller (B14c). An if is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B25c_median_not_a_class
lemmas.statement: median |cos α_3| ~ 1/2 on E_c is a geometric class that bounds X
lemmas.why: Random on the sphere is not a class. Majda: do not promote CONC to a geometric type.

lemmas.name: B25d_cf_not_bkm
lemmas.statement: the CF conditional on E_c is Beale–Kato–Majda
lemmas.why: A smaller stretching efficiency on a subset of E_c is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. Do not glue Constantin–Fefferman to Biot–Savart.

lemmas.name: B25e_budget_leftover
lemmas.statement: the aligned stretching budget closes X
lemmas.why: Scored as B15e / B26. A share of (ω·Sω)_+ is not continuation. Enstrophy balance is not an a priori (B16e). Coherent leftover is B17e. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B25f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring alignment as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. Alignment is a knob on the estimate: a number you can miss. No Q1. No ε.

next_da_move: Packet geometry is not an a priori (B14d). Stretching budget is not an a priori (B15e). Enstrophy balance is not an a priori (B16e). Coherent leftover is B17e. Finer (n>32) stays a box knob (B22e). Do not spawn n=64. B4c stands. Do not cancel to Φ.
